<cat>global</cat>
<function name="SaveAddonPresets" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Sets the content of `addonpresets.txt` located in the `garrysmod/settings` folder. By default, this file stores your addon presets as JSON.

You can use <page>Global.LoadAddonPresets</page> to retrieve the data in this file.
	</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="JSON" type="string">The new contents of the file.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
